GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-11-04T14:52:58Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Improper precedence of or operator in combination with not in pattern matching?
Description: **Version 5**: 

**Steps to Reproduce**:

System.Data.ParameterDirection.Output is not (System.Data.ParameterDirection.Input or System.Data.ParameterDirection.Output) will return false,

but 
System.Data.ParameterDirection.Output is not System.Data.ParameterDirection.Input or System.Data.ParameterDirection.Output will return true

Have in mind that the pattern and the second operand of the or operator need to be the same for this to be reproduced.

**Expected Behavior**:
What I expected from an or operator is for the not to be applied after the or. However, it seems that without the parentheses, this is not the case. This has led to some nasty bugs in our products.

I tried ParameterDirection.Output is not ParameterDirection.Input or not ParameterDirection.Output, however it returned true as well. Soo it seems that there is some very very tricky moment with the operator precedence. Could you elaborate in what order are the operators resolved, and what is the reason behind it? Or is this not expected? I surely did not expect it.

**Actual Behavior**:
Well, I stated it in the steps to reproduce :)
